.), and, according to Mallināthaʼs comment on the line

 by her father to king Sañjaya, but that she offered herself to Udayana;

). But the Vāsavadattā of Subandhu has nothing in common
 with the story of Vatsa, except the name of the heroine, as she is represented

 Kandarpaketu. It is probable that there were several heroines bearing
 the name Vāsavadattā.]
